step.cmd: In FTS, select the Renewal/Revised (M106) transaction to create an Operational Centre Memo (MM06) as follows:

ul.li: Registration number: Select the revised registration corresponding to the investigation.
Message: Select 1 - An overpayment resulted due to a disqualification .

step.cmd: When the Operational Centre Memo (MM06) transaction opens, send the information to IPOC as follows:

ul.li: Registration number: Select the revised registration corresponding to the investigation.
BPC: Select the BPC of the claim on which the misrepresentation was made.

Work item: Select the appropriate option:
If the transaction impacts cycling claimant’s reports on a blocked claim, select 93 - Manual Pay System .
If there are no cycling claimant’s reports, select 91 - Overpayment .

Work type: Select the appropriate option:
If the Work item is 91 , select 1 - Misrepresentation .
If the Work item is 93 , select 33 - Blocked claim requiring payment .

Remarks line 1: Indicate all of the following that are applicable:
Whether additional information is being provided on another Operational Centre Memo (MM06) transaction. For example, Page 1 of 3, Page 2 of 3.
URGENT: If urgent, provide reason. (e.g. URGENT approaching time limitation for penalty)
DQ: Disqualification information. (e.g. DQ 75Z01-10-9999-1725)

Remarks line 2: Indicate all of the following:
P: penalty percentage including mitigating circumstances
LMR: 1st, 2nd or 3rd level of misrepresentation (for the penalty percentage)
MPA: maximum penalty amount
VLN: violation information (V-1-0)
LVA: legal validation amount
Integrity case number
Example

Remarks line 3: Type one of the following instructions for the ACS letter:
Send stored D-91-00-00 letter [correspondence ID].
Add [missing fields] to D-91-00-00 letter [correspondence ID] and send.
Amend D-91-00-00 letter [correspondence ID] if applicable (re: reconsideration limitation) and send.
Remarks line 5: Indicate your name and telephone number.
